Rules: Here is any special rules that apply to this terrain card (Normally ojectives and scoring).\\This card gives 1 point to the defenders, 2 to the attackers, and has 4 tokens
\emph{Power reactors}:\\Each power reactor has 2 hitpoints and can be attacked. Attackers score if 2 or more are destroyed, else defenders score.
\emph{Shiny thing}:\\Frames pick up the shiny thing by stepping on it; they drop it to a neignoring tile on damage. Team holding it at the end scores.
\emph{Triangle}:\\If only one team has a frame on the triangle, they score

\emph{Extraction}:\\ Put a fugitive token anywhere in the enemy half after deployment. Token moves along with any ally touching it. Defenders score if it reaches the objective point, else attackers score.
\emph{Holo-spires}:\\If there are any attacking frames on any of the holo spires at the end, attackers score, else defenders score.
\emph{Church}:\\ If only one team has a frame within 2 of the church, they score.
